extraction_note: One of the ~10 reclass_reason cases explicitly named in README §1 bullet 3, and one the README itself says was already spot-checked ('Verified once already for web3bugs_59_H_05') and confirmed to correctly land on L4a for the right reason (Type B — the needed values userMaltPurchased/userCommitment are another contract's state with no in-scope proxy, not merely a call result with a known bound; README §4's known-bound-rescue note explicitly lists this case as a confirmed rescue FAILURE).
